rules.description: C# must be a thin interface only. Zero business logic in C#. WebGL uses jslib fetch + Avatar SDK, Editor uses UnityWebRequest.
WebGL uses jslib (fetch + Avatar SDK decryption). Editor uses UnityWebRequest. Both paths in AvatarClient.cs selected via #if UNITY_WEBGL && !UNITY_EDITOR.
GetProfile, GetAvatarList, GetActiveAvatar require a valid access token. Public APIs (GetPublicAvatarList, GetPublicAvatarByID) do NOT require auth.
Use AccessToken header for JWT tokens. No Authorization: Bearer. Editor uses UnityWebRequest.SetRequestHeader('AccessToken', token).
VRM loading MUST live in a separate MonoBehaviour (VrmAvatarController). AvatarClient.cs has ZERO UniVRM dependency. This separation prevents build errors when UniVRM is not installed.
WebGL VRM loading MUST use RuntimeOnlyNoThreadAwaitCaller. The default caller deadlocks in single-threaded WebGL. Editor uses RuntimeOnlyAwaitCaller.
WebGL VRM download stores bytes in JS-side buffer (downloadedBuffers[bridgeId]). C# copies via GCHandle.Alloc(Pinned) + HEAPU8.set(). Always Free() the handle after copy.
Before loading VRM, validate first 4 bytes are glTF magic (0x67 0x6C 0x54 0x46). If not, the file may still be encrypted (Avatar SDK decryption failed or unavailable).
WebGL jslib loads Avatar SDK (v1.1.1) for downloadAndDecrypt(). This handles encrypted VRM files. Falls back to plain fetch if Avatar SDK unavailable.
WebGL builds strip unused shaders. For proper VRM materials, add VRM/MToon10 shaders to Project Settings > Graphics > Always Included Shaders.
